title: 最好的生意：竟是弹球机，350美元逼出神秘先生？

segments.en: I'm David Rubenstein. I'm the host of David Rubenstein peer-to-peer conversations on Bloomberg TV.

segments.en: As we celebrate 10 years of conversations with some of the world's most interesting and influential leaders, we're looking back at a few of my favorite moments.
